view: Tulum El Castillo from adjacent coastal bluff, low compact weathered Maya temple on modest stepped base atop limestone sea cliff, small crescent sandy landing beach below and turquoise Caribbean, coastal shrubs foreground. Low coastal building not huge jungle pyramid, no boats required no modern tourists railings or resort.

eras.title: A temple above the landing
eras.caption: Tulum's Castillo stands on the cliff above a small Caribbean beach. Its compact temple and stone platform overlook the coast along which Maya traders travelled by canoe, while the town's walls protected the landward approaches.
